h1: Napalai Hotel — an affordable city hotel near Central Plaza, Udon Thani
intro: If you want a stay in central Udon that's easy on the wallet, a few minutes' drive from Central Plaza and UD Town, with a pool to cool off in — Napalai Hotel is a name budget-minded travellers in Udon mention often · It's a long-established city hotel, open since 1996 and partly renovated in 2019 · 145 rooms with a pool, gym and free airport shuttle · from approx. ฿790/night · scored 8.4 from real guest reviews.

body.html: Napalai Hotel is a 145-room midrange hotel on Pracharaksa Road in Ban Lueam, central Udon Thani · Its main draw is the in-town location — about a 4-minute drive to Central Plaza and 5 minutes to UD Town · It sits right next to the National Sports University campus and within walking distance of Pho Si Market · A long-standing city hotel open since 1996 and partly renovated in 2019, it's long been known locally as a venue for banquets, weddings and seminars.

Rooms range from Superior and Deluxe up to Executive and a roughly 96 sqm Family Suite · Reviews agree the rooms are spacious and clean, beds are comfortable, and many higher-floor rooms have nice city views · For this price, you get more space than the newer downtown hotels where rooms tend to be small · To be straight about it, because the building is old, some rooms feel dated — reviews mention peeling wall paint, dim lighting, and shower water that runs hot and cold in places, so if you want a room in good shape, ask for a renovated one at check-in.
"Rooms are bigger than the price suggests, clean, with a nice city view from the window, friendly front-desk staff and a decent breakfast — great value for a central Udon hotel at this rate."

The hotel has an outdoor pool, a gym, the Pah-Kao restaurant and a café · The pool is where opinions split — some find it pleasant, while others complain the water is too cold and the surrounds look dated · The gym is also called old by some guests · Breakfast is a buffet (charged at around ฿200 per adult on some packages) with a good variety that many say is tastier than expected · There's free parking and a free airport shuttle, which are real advantages here.

Service is another area where reviews diverge · Many praise the friendly, helpful reception, but some met staff who didn't speak much English, a card machine that failed, or housekeeping that didn't fully service the room on certain days · One more thing to know: the hotel has an in-house nightclub (Rhythm Bar), which can get noisy on some nights, so if you're sensitive to noise, ask for a room away from that zone.

The overall picture from reviews is a hotel that offers good space and location for the money, as long as you accept the age of the building · Scores on the main booking platforms are solid, while TripAdvisor reviews — skewing more towards international tourists — are tougher, reflecting that if you expect a crisp new hotel, this isn't it · But measured on value per baht in central Udon, Napalai still satisfies many guests.

Bottom line from real guest reviews: Napalai Hotel suits travellers who want a cheap central-Udon base near Central Plaza and UD Town, with spacious rooms, a pool and a free airport shuttle · It's a fit for budget travellers, people in town for work, and those connecting on to Nong Khai or Vientiane who don't mind that the hotel isn't new · But if you're after fresh design, flawless rooms and consistently sharp service, you'll want to add budget and look at the newer boutique hotels in town.

A tip from reading the reviews: ask for a renovated higher-floor room away from the nightclub zone for both the city view and quiet · If you'll use the airport shuttle, give the front desk your flight details in advance, and compare room-only versus breakfast-included rates before booking, since some packages bundle breakfast at better value.

honestSummary: Napalai Hotel is the best pick for travellers who want a cheap central-Udon base near Central Plaza and UD Town, with spacious rooms, a pool and a free airport shuttle · But you have to accept it's a long-established city hotel — the building and some rooms feel dated and upkeep is uneven, so pick a renovated room and flag any issue early.
honestChecks: If you expect a crisp new design hotel in every corner — the building is old and some rooms feel dated with peeling paint → ask for a renovated higher-floor room, or add budget for a newer boutique hotel in town.
If you're sensitive to noise — the hotel has an in-house nightclub that can be loud on some nights → request a room away from the nightclub zone and on a higher floor.
If you'll need a lot of English communication — some staff speak limited English and the card machine has failed before → carry backup cash and use a translation app at check-in.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Napalai Hotel Udon Thani

faq.q: Where is Napalai Hotel and what's nearby?
faq.a: Napalai Hotel sits at 572 Pracharaksa Road, Ban Lueam, Mueang Udon Thani, in the city centre · It's about a 4-minute drive to Central Plaza and 5 minutes to UD Town · It's right next to the National Sports University campus, close to Pho Si Market (~1 km) and around 4 km (8 minutes) from Udon Thani Airport.

faq.q: How much does Napalai Hotel cost and what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start at approx. ฿790/night for a Superior Room · Larger options include the Deluxe Room, an Executive Room (higher floor with city views) and a roughly 96 sqm Family Suite · High-season and holiday rates rise, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Napalai Hotel have a pool and an airport shuttle?
faq.a: Yes to both · the hotel has an outdoor pool, a gym and a free Udon Thani airport shuttle, plus free parking · Some reviews note the pool water is fairly cold and the surrounds look dated, but overall these are amenities that are hard to find at this price.

faq.q: Is Napalai Hotel old? What condition are the rooms in?
faq.a: The hotel has been open since 1996 and was partly renovated in 2019 · Rooms are spacious and clean, but the building is old and some rooms feel dated — reviews mention peeling wall paint and dim lighting · Ask for a renovated higher-floor room for both a city view and a better room condition.

faq.q: Who is Napalai Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for budget travellers who want a central-Udon base near Central Plaza and UD Town, with spacious rooms, a pool and a free airport shuttle · It suits people in town for work, travellers connecting on to Nong Khai or Vientiane, and families wanting a large suite at an affordable price.

faq.q: What are the downsides to know before booking Napalai Hotel?
faq.a: As a long-established hotel, the building and some rooms feel dated and housekeeping can be inconsistent on certain days · There's an in-house nightclub that can be noisy some nights, some staff speak limited English, and the card machine has failed before · Choosing a renovated higher-floor room and carrying backup cash helps a lot.
